skill.name: Conditional Trace Initialization
skill.description: Activate trace recording for data capture when auto_start_session=False in agentops.init(). Use the @trace decorator or agentops.start_trace() to manually enable trace recording and ensure operations are captured.
skill.skill_body:
When agentops.init() is configured with auto_start_session=False, you must explicitly activate trace recording before any operations will be recorded. Apply the @trace decorator to functions or call agentops.start_trace() manually to begin recording a logical unit of work.

## Objective

Activate trace recording for data capture in non-auto-start sessions
## Applicable Signals

- auto_start_session parameter set to False
- No automatic session recording active
- Operations need to be grouped or tracked

## Contraindications

- auto_start_session=True (traces are already active by default)
- No data recording is required for the session
- Session does not use agentops instrumentation

## Workflow Steps

- Check agentops.init() configuration for auto_start_session parameter
- If auto_start_session=False, choose activation method: @trace decorator or manual start_trace()
- For decorator method: import trace from agentops.sdk.decorators and apply @trace to target function
- For manual method: call agentops.start_trace() before operations to record
- Verify trace is active and ready to capture operation data

## Constraints

- Must be applied before operations that need recording
- Requires agentops SDK to be imported and initialized
- Only necessary when auto_start_session=False

## Output Contract

- Trace is active and recording; confirmed by successful @trace decorator application or start_trace() call returning without error. Subsequent operations within the trace scope are captured.
